root_cause: connection pool leak in checkout-service: connections acquired on the inventory call path are never returned, so the pool saturates and every later request times out waiting for one

evidence.observation: rose from 0.0 to 0.778 and stayed saturated through the window
evidence.supports: the pool is exhausted, not merely busy

evidence.observation: 10 leaked connections, an event absent from the baseline
evidence.supports: connections are acquired and not returned — the leak itself
requests fail waiting for a connection, downstream of the exhaustion

evidence.observation: rose from 0.0 to 0.9633 once the pool was saturated
evidence.supports: the user-visible impact follows the pool, it does not precede it

ruled_out: bad release (v2.8 deployment) - no deployment event appears in the window, and both db_pool_timeout and connection_leaked carry version=v2.7, so the running version did not change

inventory-service internal error masked as out-of-stock — dependency_failures[inventory-service] rose only to 0.1842 while db_pool_usage saturated, so the pool is the constraint and the 409s sit downstream of it
memory leak — process_memory_rss_mb and app_cache_entries both stayed inside their baseline range and were not flagged anomalous
